title: Inbox Support Assistant (TEST)
description: Practice sorting a sample inbox, flagging urgent messages, and drafting short replies for review.

ti.title: ሓጋዚ ምምሕዳር ኢመይል (ፈተነ)
ti.description: ናሙና ኢንቦክስ ምድባ፡ ኣገዳሲ መልእኽትታት ምልካይን ንምግምጋም ሓጸርቲ መልስታት ምድላውን ተለማመድ።

om.title: Gargaaraa Sanduuqa Ergaa (YAALII)
om.description: Sanduuqa ergaa fakkeenyaa ramaduu, ergaawwan ariifachiisoo mallatteessuu fi deebii gabaabaa qormaataaf barreessuu shaakali.

so.title: Kaaliyaha Sanduuqa Farriimaha (Tijaabo)
so.description: Ku tababar kala saaridda sanduuq farriimo tusaale ah, calaamadinta farriimaha degdegga ah iyo diyaarinta jawaabo gaagaaban oo dib loo eego.

title: Spreadsheet Helper (TEST)
description: Clean a practice spreadsheet by checking dates, removing duplicate sample rows, and labeling columns.

ti.title: ሓጋዚ ሰንጠረዥ (ፈተነ)
ti.description: ኣብ ሰንጠረዥ ልምምድ ዕለታት ብምርግጋጽ፡ ተደጋገምቲ ናሙና ረድፍታት ብምእላይን ዓምድታት ብምስያምን ኣጽርዮ።

om.title: Gargaaraa Gabatee (YAALII)
om.description: Guyyaa mirkaneessuun, tarreewwan fakkeenyaa irra deddeebi'an haquun fi tarree gabatee maqaa itti kennuun gabatee shaakalaa qulqulleessi.

so.title: Kaaliyaha Xaashida Xisaabta (Tijaabo)
so.description: Nadiifi xaashi tusaale ah adigoo hubinaya taariikhaha, saaraya safafka tusaalaha ee soo noqnoqda, una samaynaya tiirar magacyo.

title: Calendar Coordinator (TEST)
description: Organize a sample weekly calendar and prepare clear meeting reminders using a practice schedule.

ti.title: ወሃዲ ካላንደር (ፈተነ)
ti.description: ናሙና ሰሙናዊ ካላንደር ኣዳሉ፡ ኣብ ልምምድ መደብ ተመርኲስካ ንጹር መዘኻኸሪ ኣኼባ ኣዳሉ።

om.title: Qindeessaa Kalandarii (YAALII)
om.description: Kalandarii torbee fakkeenyaa qindeessi, sagantaa shaakalaa fayyadamuun yaadachiisa walga'ii ifa ta'e qopheessi.

so.title: Isku-duwaha Jadwalka (Tijaabo)
so.description: Habee jadwal toddobaadle ah oo tusaale ah, kuna diyaari xusuusinno kulan oo cad adigoo adeegsanaya jadwal tababar.
accommodations: Waqti dheeraad ah oo hawlaha wareysiga ah

title: Customer Reply Assistant (TEST)
description: Sort example customer questions and write polite draft replies from a short information sheet.

ti.title: ሓጋዚ መልሲ ዓሚል (ፈተነ)
ti.description: ናሙና ሕቶታት ዓማዊል ምድብ፡ ካብ ሓጺር ሓበሬታ ብኣኽብሮት ዝተጻሕፉ መልስታት ኣዳሉ።

om.title: Gargaaraa Deebii Maamilaa (YAALII)
om.description: Gaaffilee maamilaa fakkeenyaa ramadi, waraqaa odeeffannoo gabaabaa irraa deebii kabajaa qabu barreessi.

so.title: Kaaliyaha Jawaabaha Macaamiisha (Tijaabo)
so.description: Kala saar su'aalaha macaamiisha tusaalaha ah oo ka qor jawaabo edeb leh xaashi xog gaaban.

title: Research Organizer (TEST)
description: Put supplied public practice links into a table and summarize each source in one plain sentence.

ti.title: ኣዳላዊ ምርምር (ፈተነ)
ti.description: ዝተዋህቡ ህዝባዊ መላግቦታት ልምምድ ኣብ ሰንጠረዥ ኣእቱ፡ ንነፍሲ ወከፍ ምንጪ ብሓደ ቀሊል ሓረግ ጠቓልል።

om.title: Qindeessaa Qorannoo (YAALII)
om.description: Geessituuwwan shaakalaa ummataaf dhiyaatan gabatee keessa kaa'i, madda tokkoon tokkoon isaa hima salphaan gabaabsi.

so.title: Abaabulaha Cilmi-baarista (Tijaabo)
so.description: Geli xiriirrada tababarka ee dadweynaha la siiyey miis, kuna soo koob il kasta hal jumlad oo fudud.

title: Content Checker (TEST)
description: Review sample web copy for missing headings, unclear sentences, and simple spelling mistakes.

ti.title: መርማሪ ትሕዝቶ (ፈተነ)
ti.description: ኣብ ናሙና ጽሑፍ ዌብ ዝጎደሉ ርእስታት፡ ዘይንጹር ሓረጋትን ቀለልቲ ጌጋታት ኣጸሓሕፋን ፈትሽ።

om.title: Mirkaneessaa Qabiyyee (YAALII)
om.description: Barruu weeb fakkeenyaa mata-duree dhabame, hima hin ifne fi dogoggora qubeessuu salphaa qabu qoradhu.

so.title: Hubiyaha Nuxurka (Tijaabo)
so.description: Dib u eeg qoraal web tusaale ah si aad u ogaato cinwaanno maqan, jumlado aan caddayn iyo khaladaad higgaad fudud.
accommodations: Waqti dheeraad ah oo hawlaha wareysiga ah

title: Project Notes Assistant (TEST)
description: Turn a practice meeting transcript into a short list of decisions, tasks, and due dates.

ti.title: ሓጋዚ መዘኻኸሪ ፕሮጀክት (ፈተነ)
ti.description: ጽሑፍ ልምምድ ኣኼባ ናብ ሓጺር ዝርዝር ውሳነታት፡ ዕማማትን ዕለታት ምውዳእን ቀይሮ።

om.title: Gargaaraa Yaadannoo Pirojektii (YAALII)
om.description: Barruu walga'ii shaakalaa irraa murtiiwwan, hojiiwwan fi guyyaa xumuraa tarree gabaabaa qopheessi.

so.title: Kaaliyaha Qoraallada Mashruuca (Tijaabo)
so.description: Qoraalka kulan tababar u beddel liis gaaban oo go'aanno, hawlo iyo taariikho dhammaad ah.

title: Digital File Organizer (TEST)
description: Arrange a set of practice documents into named folders and write a clear index for the sample files.

ti.title: ኣዳላዊ ዲጂታላዊ ፋይል (ፈተነ)
ti.description: ናሙና ሰነዳት ኣብ ስሞም ዝተሰየሙ ፎልደራት ኣዳሉ፡ ንናሙና ፋይላት ንጹር መዝገብ ጽሓፍ።

om.title: Qindeessaa Faayilii Dijitaalaa (YAALII)
om.description: Galmeewwan shaakalaa galmee maqaa qabu keessatti qindeessi, faayilota fakkeenyaatiif tarree ifa ta'e barreessi.

so.title: Abaabulaha Faylasha Dijitaalka ah (Tijaabo)
so.description: Ku hagaaji dukumentiyo tababar galal magac leh, una qor tusmo cad oo faylasha tusaalaha ah.
